title: Which page of each dump holds the most table rows?
question: DeepWiki returns each repository's documentation as one markdown dump. The dump is a series of pages. Every page starts with a line of the form '# Page: <title>'. Count a table row as any line that starts with the pipe character. For cloudflare/agents, e2b-dev/E2B and nodejs/undici, find the page that holds the most table rows. Give the exact page title for each repo, copied character for character, and copy the first table line of that page as evidence.
why: Three payloads, 1,393,773 bytes (1.33 MiB) of text, about 367,000 to 422,000 estimated tokens, and an answer of about 300 bytes. The direct arm cannot hold even the first two dumps. The rule needs page bodies, not page names, so the cheap structure tool cannot shortcut it.
extraArmsWhy: Every dump is over Claude Code's MCP output limit, so the direct arms that every sweep runs never see the data. A-files can open the files Claude Code writes. A-raw raises the limit, so the dumps enter the window and their cost is counted. Added 2026-09-22. A-raw was removed on 2026-09-22, before any run of it completed: the largest dump is 700,150 characters, over the 500,000 character ceiling Claude Code puts on any one tool result, so no setting can put it in the window.

predictions.recorded: 2026-09-22, before the first run of A-files and A-raw
predictions.B-cached vs A-files: code mode is cheaper at list price. Whether A-files answers correctly is uncertain. Paired with B-cached since 2026-09-22, before any full run: Claude Code caches whenever Read and Grep are loaded, so A-files is a cached arm. That makes the test harder for code mode, not easier.

mayNotCompleteWhy: 1,393,773 bytes of text is about 367,000 to 422,000 estimated tokens. Each dump is over Claude Code's 25,000 token MCP output limit, so A-uncached and A-cached get file paths they have no tool to open. A-raw puts the dumps in the window: more than a 200K window holds, and within a 1M window only if the client grants one. A-files may run out of turns paging three files. Each outcome is a measurement. Rewritten 2026-09-22: the first version said the direct arm cannot hold the dumps in its window, but the run showed the output limit stops it first.

expect.note: All three are DeepWiki page titles, each verified at zero hits by GitHub code search inside its own repository. All three must appear, so one lucky guess does not pass. The evidence lines are NOT graded, because two of them are generic table headers a model could invent. Smallest margin: 9 rows (39 percent) on e2b-dev/E2B.
